query: WITH RECURSIVE target AS (SELECT id FROM playlists WHERE id = ANY($1) AND deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT p.id FROM playlists p JOIN target t ON p.parent_id = t.id WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL) UPDATE playlists SET deleted_at = COALESCE(deleted_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), deletion_source = COALESCE(deletion_source, 'account'), deleted_owner_id = COALESCE(deleted_owner_id, $2), version = version + 1 WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM target) AND deleted_at IS NULL
